scope: Selected major conditions, not an exhaustive count of all safeguards

conditions.result: persistent manual zero/PAUSED; retain worker; bounded legacy remains terminal
nonterminal Stop; no direction from watch
local guard inhibits output; not extended by UI heartbeat
discard pre-arm direction and require current input; no old deadline terminal close

conditions.trigger: board/guard sample stale, low voltage, ownership conflict

conditions.result: zero/OFF readback, connection retained; unnecessary rearm remains hardware-unverified
BUFFERING; actual queue/write/byte failure still terminal in existing robot worker
BUFFERING without nonce restamping; actual queue/byte/write failure remains terminal; separate physical telemetry transport not implemented
motion pause and INCOMPLETE; connection retained
OBSTACLE_STOP; new escape input allowed; not physical stopping qualification
capability=false with precise blockers; never SIM substitute or fake live battery
